name: @gubbins/bridge
//version: Deliberately absent: the bridge ships as source inside this repo and has no separate release, so it reports the repository's version (see src/version.ts). A second number here could only drift.
description: Gubbins companion bridge — hydrates a gubbins-sync.json snapshot into a headless node:sqlite database and runs the app's own read-only search code. Optional, local-first, never part of the PWA / GitHub-Pages build.
author: Joe Cox <BootBlock@users.noreply.github.com>
//engines: The floor at which the bridge is self-sufficient — no flags. v22.18.0 is where type-stripping stopped needing --experimental-strip-types, and the whole v23.x line is excluded because node:sqlite's FTS5 support was never backported to it. node-version.mjs enforces this at startup (a shade more permissively: it lets an older v22 through when the user supplies the flag), and a unit test keeps the two in step.
